The '''Judicial Academy''' was the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] training academy on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]] would attend the academy before becoming [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
